title: Lebanese Culinary Culture
summary: Lebanese: sumac and zaatar, pita, olive oil.
origins: Lebanese cuisine reflects middle east geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Shared plates, warm spices, and balance of grain, legume, and herb.
teaching: Toast spices, use yogurt and tahini for richness, finish with fresh herb and pomegranate acid.
Sumac, zaatar, bulgur, chickpeas, and flatbread are pantry anchors.
Signature pairing: sumac and zaatar + pita + olive oil.
